name: codex-vault
description: Explore an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault with Codex agents, backlinks, search, and an interactive knowledge graph.

interface.shortDescription: Search and explore your local Markdown knowledge graph.
interface.longDescription: Codex Vault adapts Foam's Markdown knowledge graph and MCP tools for local, agent-assisted note exploration in Codex. It starts in read-only mode and supports Obsidian-style wikilinks, backlinks, tags, and graph traversal.
defaultPrompt: 搜尋我的 Vault，整理與這個主題最相關的筆記。
顯示目前筆記的 backlinks 與相鄰知識節點。
找出 Vault 中的孤立筆記與失效連結。
